data.title: 请求状态码
data.content: [{"table":{"tbody":[{"stateyCode":"400","stateyCodeDescribe":"请求参数无效，这可能是由于参数缺失、格式错误或者超出了有效范围。","stateyCodeName":"BC_0001","stateyCodeInfo":"InvalidArgument"},{"stateyCode":"400","stateyCodeDescribe":"表⽰请求的资源已经存在。这可能是由于试图创建⼀个已经存在的资源。","stateyCodeName":"BC_0002","stateyCodeInfo":"AlreadyExists"},{"stateyCode":"400","stateyCodeDescribe":"表⽰没有执⾏操作的权限。这可能是由于⾝份验证失败、访问被拒绝或者没有⾜够的权限执⾏操作。","stateyCodeName":"BC_0003","stateyCodeInfo":"PermissionDenied\n"},{"stateyCode":"400","stateyCodeDescribe":"表示请求能够正常执行的服务端状态和当前服务端的状态不一致，例如，应用实例正在删掉中，请求再一次请求删除实例。","stateyCodeName":"BC_0004","stateyCodeInfo":"FailedPrecondition"},{"stateyCode":"400","stateyCodeDescribe":"表示请求端的用户没有权限，当前情况需要检查是否登录信息已经过期，重新刷新页面。","stateyCodeName":"BC_0005","stateyCodeInfo":"Unauthenticated"},{"stateyCode":"400","stateyCodeDescribe":"表示请求端的请求发送到服务端，服务端发生了内部处理错误。","stateyCodeName":"BC_0006","stateyCodeInfo":"Internal"},{"stateyCode":"400","stateyCodeDescribe":"表示请求的资源已经耗尽或者售罄。","stateyCodeName":"BC_0007","stateyCodeInfo":"ResourceExhausted"},{"stateyCode":"400","stateyCodeDescribe":"表示请求的资源或者方法不存在。","stateyCodeName":"BC_0008","stateyCodeInfo":"NotFound"}],"thead":[{"stateyCode":"状态码"},{"stateyCodeName":"错误码"},{"stateyCodeInfo":"状态信息"},{"stateyCodeDescribe":"描述"}],"title":"请求状态码","isRootNode":"是"}}]
